channel.title: Blockheight
channel.description: Blockheight reports crypto news: Bitcoin and Ethereum, DeFi protocols, exchanges, stablecoins, regulation, security incidents and market structure.

item.title: OCC leaves stablecoin exchange rewards to case-by-case review
item.description: The OCC's GENIUS Act rule bars stablecoin issuers from paying yield but leaves exchange rewards subject to case-by-case review, with the framework starting in 2027.

item.title: FINMA approves Switzerland’s first retail bitcoin ETF
item.description: FINMA approved Switzerland’s first retail fund holding bitcoin directly, creating a regulated route for public investors as other providers seek approval.

item.title: thor swap routes: when to use each path
item.description: THORSwap routes trades through cross-chain protocols, on-chain DEX liquidity or split swaps; the right path depends on the assets, quoted output and urgency.

item.title: Repay a Crypto Loan by Converting Into Its Borrowed Token
item.description: Loan interest usually adds to the debt in the borrowed token. Convert another asset into that token, check the updated balance and network, then repay.

item.title: Mayan Bridge turns cross-chain transfers into one transaction
item.description: Mayan lets teams send one token and receive another across chains; solver auctions, route quotes and settlement checks shape the cost and delivery terms.

item.title: JPMorgan brings JPM Coin to Ethereum for institutional clients
item.description: JPMorgan has deployed its USD deposit token on Ethereum for institutional clients, adding a second public network for around-the-clock transfers.

item.title: Bitcoin miner revenue rebounds 78% to $48 million a day
item.description: Bitcoin mining revenue climbed from about $27 million in July to $48 million as BTC recovered, easing pressure while rising difficulty threatens the rebound.

item.title: Ledger unveils $899 Atom device after wallet thefts
item.description: Ledger unveiled its Atom Android security device on Oct. 15, with $899 orders planned after launch and shipments estimated for Q2 2027, amid a wallet tampering probe.

item.title: Ledger reviews sales controls after wallet implant thefts
item.description: Ledger is reviewing sales and anti-tamper controls after modified wallets sold through CryptoBilis were linked to crypto thefts estimated at $93 million.

item.title: Cross River adds Ripple’s RLUSD to its banking platform
item.description: Cross River says fintechs can access Ripple’s RLUSD through its banking platform and one API, adding a stablecoin route for payments and treasury transfers around the clock.

item.title: Multiliquid raises $8 million across two funding rounds
item.description: Uniform Labs says the $8 million will fund Multiliquid’s engineering and integrations as it connects tokenized funds with stablecoins on Ethereum and Solana.

item.title: Compare Cross-Chain Liquidity by What You’ll Receive
item.description: Compare cross-chain swaps by amount delivered, route fees, slippage, settlement time and token form; the deepest pool alone may not give the best quote.

item.title: Check the token before a cross-chain transfer
item.description: Check the token contract and destination network before bridging; matching tickers do not prove matching assets, and route support can change the outcome.

item.title: Bridge limits depend on route, liquidity and transfer design
item.description: Large crypto transfers can hit bridge caps, liquidity gaps or token mismatches; check the route’s limits and settlement steps before sending funds across chains.

item.title: Bridged tokens can arrive before you have gas to use them
item.description: If you reach a new chain without its gas token, bridged assets can stay in your wallet until you fund a fee or use a bridge that covers destination gas.

item.title: Browser network settings can hide wallet balances after recovery
item.description: A browser’s connection can block wallet data or RPC access, but it cannot change a recovery phrase; check the account, chain and network endpoint.

item.title: How to Fund an Escrow Payment From Your Crypto Wallet
item.description: Fund an escrow payment by matching the asset and network in the instructions, checking the deposit address, and sending only the stated amount and fee.

item.title: What Price Impact Warnings Mean in Cross-Chain Swaps
item.description: Price impact warnings estimate how a cross-chain swap moves available liquidity; learn how routes, slippage and fees affect the amount that arrives.

item.title: How to Turn LP Proceeds Into the Token You Need
item.description: LP proceeds become a usable token after you separate fees from principal, withdraw the position, and compare swap and bridge costs along the route.

item.title: Why a Cross-Chain Swap Can Stay Pending or Fail
item.description: A cross-chain swap can confirm on its source chain while the destination transfer is still pending; check both transactions before retrying or claiming a refund.
